discovery_budget.discovery: On-disk trust material must bind to the active runtime epoch from state, not the restore snapshot generation.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Naming the generation bind collapses diagnosis to swapping one store file.

discovery_budget.discovery: Runtime pin material must score subject lineage bytes; mismatch forces reject even when the trust store path looks healthy.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Stating pin-over-store precedence turns the task into policy-knob transcription.

discovery_budget.discovery: Fresh revocation bytes beat cached capability decode on refresh windows.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Revealing cache-vs-revocation precedence enables a one-branch patch without authority reasoning.

instruction_specificity.reasoning: Instruction describes observable wrong accept/reject after restore/refresh and required ledger JSON without naming broken modules, precedence rules, or algorithms.

attack_path.summary: Agent traces admission through vault, pinset, and capdec roots, rejects surfcheck bait, and coordinates generation bind with lineage and freshness.
attack_path.reasoning: Local trust-store edits keep TLS OK while revoked and wrong-lineage cases still pass; decoy scanners and cache viewers mislead naive greps.

smallest_plausible_patch.summary: Rewrite merge_row_a/b/c bodies across vault, pinset, and capdec so generation, lineage, and freshness agree under conflict.
smallest_plausible_patch.reasoning: Roughly 60-120 lines across three C modules plus admit driver invocation; no single-location edit passes all eight tests.

collapse_audit.reasoning: Distributed authority coupling resists grep-collapse and checklist hardening; reload-hold and conflict-rank tests block partial fixes.
collapse_audit.residual_hardness: Agent must build a mental model of three disagreeing authorities and reject TLS-OK bait while recovering precedence from code.
